verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT is a discrete graphics card. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows belongs to the OS, orchestrators, or cron-style tools, not to GPU hardware, so this is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the card or its software (ROCm, AMD Software, HYPR-RX) shipping a job scheduler. Docker and third-party inference servers like vLLM are host or external tools and would not count anyway.
